description: This file declares an interface IWebSocketClient for WebSocket client implementations, along with related utilities such as ConnectionType enumeration and a helper function getConnectionType() to determine connection security based on URI.

classes.name: IWebSocketClient
classes.description: An abstract interface defining WebSocket client operations such as connect, disconnect, and retrieving connection type.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Pure virtual function to connect to a WebSocket server with the specified URI.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Pure virtual function to disconnect from the WebSocket server.

methods.name: getConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the connection type (secured or unsecured) of the WebSocket connection.
